tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Tonal buttons, search fields, segmented-control tracks, code/identifier chips.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating layers: bottom sheets, popovers, the running-timer bar. Pair with shadow-lg.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Toasts and tooltips: the opposite of the theme.

tokens.name: line-hairline
tokens.usage: Row separators, card borders, table rules. 1px, never darker.

tokens.name: line-border
tokens.usage: Input borders, chips at rest, dividers that must read as an edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Checkbox/radio outlines, drag handles, icons on tonal surfaces (3:1).

tokens.name: ink-primary
tokens.usage: Titles, body copy, amounts.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Subtitles, metadata, labels, timestamps. Meets 4.5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, decorative icons, disabled-looking helper text. ≥3:1 only — never for information the user needs.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control labels.

tokens.name: ink-inverse

tokens.name: status-success-bg

tokens.usage: Saturated 8px marker in pills and rows; charts never reuse it.

tokens.usage: Solid fills: destructive-solid button, notification badge, progress.

tokens.name: status-success-on
tokens.usage: Text on the solid fill.
